title: Workspace help
text: This modal leaves the page beneath it intact. Ctrl-O opens an editable confirmation above this help. Esc returns one frame at a time. The action palette exposes both framework operations and the separate workspace action registry.

title: Release confirmation
text: Edit the confirmation note. Ctrl-N opens a second editable modal. Ctrl-S invokes the editor-specific save handler. Esc returns without destroying page state.

title: Nested release details
text: This is a nested modal with its own input. Edit independently, then Esc returns to the previous modal and restores its focus.
